company.shortDescription: Arabia Weddings is an online wedding planning platform that helps to transform wedding planning process into an easy and affordable process.
company.description:
Arabia Weddings is an online wedding planning platform that helps to transform wedding planning process into an easy and affordable process. It supports people in the Middle East and North Africa to plan their wedding in few simple steps. The platform also creates and produces interesting articles, galleries, videos, and wedding planning tools to guide its users and give them plenty of inspiration, ideas, and advice.

Arabia Weddings added one directory after another of the main wedding suppliers and service providers until it covered 13 countries in the GCC, Levant, and Egypt. 

Arabia Weddings was launched in 2012 and is based in Amman. The platform is available in both Arabic and English languages.
